# iosxe_wireless_ap_filter (Resource)

This resource can manage an AP filter (`ap filter name`), which assigns policy, site and RF tags to access points whose name matches a regular expression. A filter only takes effect once it has a priority, see `iosxe_wireless_ap_filter_priority`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_wireless_ap_filter" "example" {
  name          = "S3-AF-TEST"
  ap_name_regex = "^S3-AP-TEST-.*"
  tag_policy    = "S3-PT-TEST"
  tag_site      = "S3-ST-TEST"
  tag_rf        = "S3-RT-TEST"
  filter_type   = "ap-filter-type-tag"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) filter name

### Optional

- `ap_name_regex` (String) regular expression string
- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `filter_type` (String) AP filter type
  - Choices: `ap-filter-type-tag`, `ap-filter-type-priming`
  - Default value: `ap-filter-type-tag`
- `tag_policy` (String) policy tag
- `tag_rf` (String) rf tag
- `tag_site` (String) site tag

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_wireless_ap_filter.example "<name>"
```
